summary: 1–3, Elders are to assemble in conference; 4–6, They are to organize according to the laws of the land and to care for the poor.
meta_description: Revelation given to Joseph Smith the Prophet and Sidney Rigdon, at Kirtland, Ohio, in the latter part of February 1831. In compliance with the requirement herein set forth, the Church appointed a conference to be held early in the month of June following.
